[[File:Portrait sela.jpg|140px|left|link=House Whitehart]]
'''[[House Whitehart]]''' keeps the [[The Bell of Silence (seat)|Bell of Silence]] in the high, silent valleys of [[the Light Heights]], where the dead rest in open niches so that their voices may carry. It is the house of '''faith''': true authority, Whitehart holds, does not come from the one who leads but ''through'' them. Its leaders are '''[[The Called|Called]]''' — and in the year 396 A.U. a goatherd named [[Sela]] has heard something no one can verify.
